text: make water that has depth for the hmsc-int editor and compiled game, give a tool for making bodies of water
resolution: Bodies of water with DEPTH for both the hmsc-int editor and the compiled no-V8 game, plus a tool to make them. GUIDING_LIGHT-aligned factored model (game/world/water.ts): a body = an AABB footprint (rect|disc) + ONE surfaceY float; depth is DERIVED at lookup (surfaceY-bed), never a stored grid — dig the bed under one and it reads deeper. Tool: a WATER shelf in the OBJECTS catalog drops thin placements (presets in game/kinds/waterBodies.ts) that re-resolve by kind, so they persist with zero mapStore changes. Editor renders a translucent slab (render3d/WaterBody) with the bed showing through as depth and the player wades (footingKindAtWorldPosition). Compiled game: NO new lump — water bakes as translucent slab instances on the existing INSTANCES/MATERIALS path glass uses (worldGeometry pushWaterBodies); world_loader.zig translucent render made shape-aware so discs draw round. 8 behavior tests pass. Follow-ups: compiled wade-slowdown + collider-fallback water-awareness.
